subject: ela
intro: Pick the author's point of view or compare it to your own.

items.prompt:
Read.

'Everyone should recycle,' the author writes.

The author's point of view is that recycling is:
A) a waste
B) important
C) boring

steps: Author favors recycling. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

'Dogs make the best pets,' the author writes.

The author's view is that:
A) dogs are the best pets
B) cats are best
C) no pets are good
items.answer: A) dogs are the best pets

solution.answer: A) dogs are the best pets

items.prompt:
Words like 'should' and 'best' usually show the author's:
A) point of view
B) page number
C) name

The author thinks recycling is best. You think planting trees helps more. Your views are:
A) the same
B) different
C) missing

Read.

'Summer is the best season,' writes the author.

If YOU love winter, your view is:
A) the same as the author's
B) different from the author's
C) the author's exactly

steps: Winter vs summer. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Which sentence shows the author's OPINION?
A) Water is made of tiny drops.
B) Everyone should drink more water.
C) Water can freeze.
items.answer: B) Everyone should drink more water.

solution.answer: B) Everyone should drink more water.

items.prompt:
Read.

'Zoos are not fair to animals and should be closed,' the author argues. But you believe zoos help protect endangered animals.

Your point of view:
A) matches the author's
B) differs from the author's
C) is the same as the facts

How can you tell the author's point of view from a plain fact?
A) The point of view uses opinion words like should or best
B) Facts always come last
C) You cannot tell
items.answer: A) The point of view uses opinion words like should or best

steps: Opinion words signal a viewpoint. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The point of view uses opinion words like should or best
